articles.title: India bonds muted after tepid response for RBI's cash-drain operation
articles.description: Indian government bonds hit a pause on Monday following a technical setback that disrupted cash withdrawal capabilities. To counteract a liquidity overflow that surged to a historic 10.73 trillion rupees last Friday, the central bank declared an overnight auction. Traders are now on edge, fearing that tighter measures may be imposed to handle the liquidity, especially with increasing oil prices and rate speculation keeping market sentiment tepid.
